Oneliner

Demonstrate payloads for the LEO-PNT (Low Earth Orbit - Positioning Navigation Timing) satellite programme.

Description

In collaboration with Thales Alenia Space, German Orbital Systems GmbH will play a crucial role in the development and operation of the cutting-edge 16U platform and associated payloads for the LEO-PNT (Low Earth Orbit - Positioning Navigation Timing) satellite programme. This partnership marks a pivotal step forward in advancing space technology – a mission with the potential to boost the Galileo constellation to new heights! In less than 18 months, our 16U tech demo satellite will showcase the incredible capabilities of our technology - made in Germany.
